answer: Every new identity needs an agent to stake 180 POA on it for 90 days, and the stake covers one identity only, so a farm pays 180 POA per extra fake. The newcomer carries an umber badge naming its sponsor, and it cannot move to another key. A bridge of six auditors, drawn at random each month, checks agents against their work logs. If an agent runs a second identity, its sponsor loses the full stake and the fake is struck off, while clean agents earn a relic mark after two years of audits.
